schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: go-islo-workdir-not-contained-under-workspace
title: Islo workdir resolved or passed to the sandbox API without checking it stays under /workspace
summary: 'The configured Islo workdir is passed to the sandbox create call as-is, or resolved by a helper
  that returns only a string with no error path. Absolute paths are accepted after `path.Clean`, and relative
  paths can escape through `..`. A malicious or mistaken config can then point sandbox creation, `rm -rf`,
  `mkdir -p` and `tar -x` at directories outside the intended /workspace.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-22
severity: medium
confidence: medium
languages:
- go

rule:
  message: 'The configured workdir is used without being validated as a relative path under the workspace
    root. Absolute paths and `..` traversal are not rejected. Resolve it with a helper that returns an
    error for absolute or escaping paths, and propagate that error to every caller.

    '
  pattern-either:
  - pattern: '$C.Workdir = $F($CFG.Islo.Workdir)

      '
  - pattern: "func isloWorkspacePath($CFG Config) string {\n    ...\n}\n"
  - pattern-regex: (?m)^\s*\w+ := isloWorkspacePath\(
fix:
  guidance: 'Require the workdir to be relative, clean it, and reject `.`, `..` and anything starting
    with `../` before joining it to the workspace root. Return an error from the resolver and have every
    caller (sandbox creation, sync, run) propagate it. Pass the cleaned relative workdir to the sandbox
    create call instead of the raw configured value.

    '
  example: "func isloRelativeWorkdir(cfg Config) (string, error) {\n    workdir := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Islo.Workdir)\n\
    \    if workdir == \"\" {\n        workdir = \"crabbox\"\n    }\n    if strings.HasPrefix(workdir,\
    \ \"/\") {\n        return \"\", exit(2, \"islo workdir %q must be relative under /workspace\", workdir)\n\
    \    }\n    workdir = path.Clean(workdir)\n    if workdir == \".\" || workdir == \"..\" || strings.HasPrefix(workdir,\
    \ \"../\") {\n        return \"\", exit(2, \"islo workdir %q escapes /workspace\", workdir)\n    }\n\
    \    return workdir, nil\n}\n\n// caller\nworkdir, err := isloRelativeWorkdir(b.cfg)\nif err != nil\
    \ {\n    return err\n}\ncreate.Workdir = stringValue(workdir)\n"
